jd_text: Bachelor/Master Graduate - 2027 Start. The Accelerated Development Program (ADP) is a rotational programme for 2027 graduates joining TikTok Shop Thailand e-commerce. Rotations cover category growth, seller development and operations. Programme starts June 2027 in Bangkok. Requirements: bachelor's or master's degree graduating in 2027; strong analytical and communication skills; leadership experience; fluent Thai and English. Selection: online test, HR interview, case day, leaders interview. Applications close 30 November 2026 or earlier when full.
